name: AbuseIPDB - All Sign-Ins from Blacklisted IPs
description: Correlates AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs with all Azure AD sign-in log types (Interactive, Non-Interactive, Service Principal, Managed Identity, and ADFS) to identify any authentication activity from known abusive IP addresses. Normalizes identity and application fields across all five sign-in tables.
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'Interactive'),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'NonInteractive'),
(AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ServicePrincipal'),
(AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ManagedIdentity'),
(ADFSSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | project TimeGenerated, Identity = UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ADFS')
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, IPAddress, AbuseScore, Country, AppName, ResultType, SignInType
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
